products.name: tl;dv
products.note: Meeting recorder AI; timestamped notes; EU-hosted; GDPR; consent management

reading.body:
tl;dv offers meeting recording and summarization across 30+ languages with user data kept off AI training pipelines, positioning itself as a cheaper alternative to competitors like Gong.

The product sits at the junction of three capabilities: recording, transcription, and automated note generation. The company's claim that recordings will not train its AI, combined with EU hosting and GDPR compliance, signals a choice to treat customer conversations as confidential rather than as training fuel. This matters because most meeting intelligence platforms treat content as a training asset. The partnership with Anthropic for generative features, with metadata anonymization and randomized processing, suggests tl;dv offloads AI compute while trying to maintain user privacy guarantees.

For an AI company, this approach trades a potential data moat for user trust and regulatory compliance. The free tier with no time limits requires the company to absorb hosting and transcription costs at scale. Transcription alone, across 30+ languages and millions of meetings, generates consistent computational demand. That demand sits downstream of data center capacity and power availability. EU data residency adds infrastructure constraints that a US-only platform avoids.

The data does not show revenue, user scale, or which languages consume the most compute. It also does not specify whether the company owns transcription infrastructure or licenses it. Whether the free tier and low-cost paid plans are sustainable at scale depends on factors the profile does not reveal.

profile_text.body:
tl;dv is a meeting recording and AI note-taking product for Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams. The company, founded in 2021 and headquartered in Aachen, describes the tool as an AI meeting notetaker that records, transcribes, and summarizes calls automatically. The name stands for "Too Long, Didn't View." The site states that tl;dv can generate video recordings, translatable transcripts, and shareable summaries, and supports transcription in 30+ supported languages. It also says the product integrates with CRMs, ticketing systems, knowledge management platforms, and over 5000+ other tools, and offers a Free Forever plan with unlimited meetings, AI-generated notes, and multi-meeting summaries at no cost. The site contrasts this with Gong, which it says requires a $5,000+ upfront investment.

The company positions tl;dv as a sales coaching platform as well, with AI-driven call analysis for tracking playbook adherence, objection handling, and rep performance. It says the AI can draft follow-up emails and next-step tasks, log call notes and CRM outcomes, and produce aggregated insights and trends from multiple conversations. New hires can review curated, AI-selected clips from real customer calls. On security, the site states that data is protected with end-to-end encryption, GDPR compliance, and SOC 2-certified security, and that recordings and transcripts are not used to train AI. It also says tl;dv partners with Anthropic for generative AI, anonymizes all metadata, and processes meetings in randomized, small chunks, with data stored in ISO 27001-certified data centers using AES-256 encryption.

tl;dv is a meeting recorder AI with timestamped notes, EU-hosted, GDPR, and consent management. No litigation or MCP server information is associated with the company.
